sprint.title: One Unambiguous Three-Hop Local Destination Traversal
sprint.goal: Resolve only one uniquely eligible three-hop authored local route for go to <location> and move to <location>, validating every hop before movement and reusing immediate movement semantics.
acceptance_criteria: go to <location> and move to <location> may traverse exactly one eligible three-hop local route and end at the canonical destination.
The complete route validates before any movement mutation; zero or multiple eligible routes fail deterministically without state change.
Each hop uses existing immediate local movement semantics; immediate and two-hop traversal behavior remains unchanged.
Resolution is derived, transient, and bounded to three hops, including cycle and unrelated-connection handling.
Save version remains 1; no persistent route state, migration, generic pathfinding, ranking, or provider behavior is introduced.

focused_commands: Affected movement, navigation, save/load, narration-context, and provider-safe regressions

governance: This owner-authorized capability package is active; no following sprint is authorized or staged.
Simulation retains authority over connections and movement; three-hop resolution is derived and transient.
The interaction kernel may resolve only one route with exactly two intermediates and must validate all hops before movement.
Do not add general pathfinding, configurable depth, ranking, persistent state, parser expansion, or excluded systems. Save version remains 1.
Provider requests are forbidden and next_sprint remains null.
